question: Does adding a balanced historical Broker Service profile improve Dynamic Need ranking when Broker Supply is not clusterable under the balance gate?
hypothesis: A service profile based on frozen response-outcome/channel/urgency mix adds useful broker heterogeneity without relying on broker_response_hours.
primary_change: add broker_service_balanced_profile while retaining the valid E012 representation
secondary_changes: branch around failed Broker Supply experiment
require service profile to pass the same 5%-65% balance gate

target.censoring: Public candidate data has no true sale timestamp; offline result is associative.

population.eligibility: Same E006/E007 temporal population and untouched future test.
exclusions: Profile-calibration rows excluded from predictive fit.

validation.strategy: same temporal train/future-test; outcome-free profile selection; paired cluster-bootstrap by lead_id
validation.split_description: Identical E006 future test; same Logistic Regression family/hyperparameters.

items.source: pre-cutoff inquiry history aggregated by broker: outcome mix, channel mix, asked_visit, urgency and message length
items.evidence: broker_response_hours is excluded. Only historical inquiries before profile cutoff contribute.
